review.notes: Automated line-level diff of extracted text from all 63 physical PDF pages against the OCR Markdown (case/punctuation/LaTeX-equivalent math normalized), followed by targeted verification of every flagged page. Pages 10, 51 and 56 were additionally rendered and visually inspected. All 145 distinct numeric values on the Codeforces table pages 27-29 are present in the OCR HTML tables with equal or greater multiplicity; all 12 tables have balanced tr/td tags; the six code fences are balanced printed prompt templates in Appendix C. Running page headers (report title, 'IMO 2025 Model Proofs'), the p.1 copyright/arXiv lines, and figure-internal prompt text on p.7 (Figure 2 embeds it) are absent from the OCR and were treated as non-defects. The PDF's own typo 'intergrated' (p.4) was silently corrected to 'integrated' by the OCR and left as printed-correction. Math-heavy proof pages 30-56 differ from the PDF text layer mainly by LaTeX-versus-Unicode-math rendering and margin anchors (A2, C6, ...), which the anchors confirmed are present.
